name: Fenproporex
summary: Fenproporex, sold under the brand name Perphoxene and also known as N-(2-cyanoethyl)amphetamine, is a stimulant drug of the phenethylamine and amphetamine chemical classes that was developed in the 1960s. It is used as an appetite suppressant for the treatment of obesity.

uses.text: Fenproporex, sold under the brand name Perphoxene and also known as N-(2-cyanoethyl)amphetamine, is a stimulant drug of the phenethylamine and amphetamine chemical classes that was developed in the 1960s. It is used as an appetite suppressant for the treatment of obesity. Fenproporex has never been approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for sale in the US due to lack of efficacy and safety data.
